name: I Became a Femboy to Date One
source:
One day you randomly happen upon the most beautiful person you have ever seen. As it turns out, he's a femboy. You fall head over heels--the only thing is, he only dates femboys... 😜

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一天，你偶然遇见了这辈子见过的最漂亮的人。原来，他是个打扮很有少女气的男孩子。你顿时坠入爱河。唯一的问题是，他也只和这样的男孩子约会…😜

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772640/]Steam[/url]）
